ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Watchers
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
WATCHER_CREATURES_MOD_1: shy creatures that sit, peek out, watch you, and jerk back under cover when anything that is not their own kind comes near. A standalone kit (owner ruling 2026-09-30); a biome's roster draws on it. Design: design/RimMandrake/watcher_creatures_kit_design_2026-10-02.md.
Ships: 1. The kit. RM_WatcherExtension on a race opts it in; the comp is injected at startup, so a member writes XML only. Hidden -> peeks out -> watches (turns to face the nearest pawn) -> flinches and hides when a non-own-kind pawn comes within its flinch radius, it is marked for hunting, or (optional geophone) something large swims under the sand nearby -> re-emerges after a delay. A hidden watcher always leaves a sign on its cell: no animal vanishes without a readable sign. 2. Medium lock: a watcher wanders only on its medium terrain and walks back to it when found off it; it only ever hides on its medium. 3. Flush (hunting is flush-only, owner ruling 2026-10-03): you cannot target a hiding watcher. Mark its sign with the Flush order; a hunter walks to it, it bolts, and while it bolts it can be hunted. 4. First member: the piinnok of the Stillsand, the watching glass, locked to deep sand. 5. Mod Settings: master, hide and flinch, turn to face, stay on medium, geophone, flush marks for hunting, flinch radius, re-emerge delay, max active watchers per map.
Works alone. With RimMandrake: FlowWorks the piinnok's medium (deep sand) exists; with RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes it filter-feeds the sand, butchers to biosilica, and its lenses sink for submerged sand swimmers.
